reproduction.timestamp_limit: Exact start UTC timestamps were not retained for most storage experiments; date, run order, offsets, byte counts and monotonic elapsed results are retained. No fabricated timestamps or signed execution credit.
reproduction.source_variable: SOURCE is the local path to the exact investigated source generation; use the appropriate NAS-local or NFS-mounted path. Host aliases are neutral.
reproduction.ffmpeg_recipe: /usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -noaccurate_seek -ss "$POSITION" -readrate_initial_burst 90.0 -readrate 2.00 -i "$SOURCE" -t 20 -map_chapters -1 -map 0:v:0? -map 0:a:0? -sn -c:v copy -tag:v hvc1 -bsf:v null -c:a eac3 -ac 6 -channel_layout:a 5.1 -b:a 640k -ar 48000 -avoid_negative_ts make_zero -movflags frag_keyframe+empty_moov+default_base_moof+delay_moov -use_editlist 0 -progress pipe:1 -nostats -f mp4 -y /dev/null
reproduction.raw_read_primitive: fd=os.open(SOURCE,os.O_RDONLY); os.lseek(fd,OFFSET,os.SEEK_SET); t=time.monotonic(); repeat os.read(fd,min(1048576,BYTES-read_total)) until BYTES or EOF; elapsed=time.monotonic()-t; os.close(fd). No fadvise or global cache drop.
reproduction.cross_client_order: lab4 then media1 at 52 GiB; media1 then lab4 at 54 GiB, 64 MiB each, sequential, no simultaneous source benchmark. Different clients did not previously read these windows in this experiment.
nas_local_recipes: time dd if="$SOURCE" of=/dev/null bs=1048576 skip=57344 count=64
time dd if="$SOURCE" of=/dev/null bs=1048576 skip=59392 count=128
reproduction.read_ahead_recipe: Read original sysfs read_ahead_kb for the production NFS backing-device identity; set 128,8192,128 for the three distinct offsets retained; use raw_read_primitive; collect /proc/self/mountstats READ deltas; finally restore original and read back. This diagnostic configuration is not a shipping setting.
reproduction.scanner_recipe: Bind pidfd to identified scan_title and verify comm/start time; raw-read A while running; arm 15-second SIGCONT timer; SIGSTOP via pidfd and verify state T; raw-read B; finally SIGCONT and cancel timer; verify resumed; raw-read C. Use the exact fresh adjacent offsets retained; protect against PID reuse. No service suspension or queue reset.
reproduction.fresh_transport_recipe: Temporary read-only nosharecache NFS4.0 mount with nconnect=8,rsize=1048576,soft,timeo=20,retrans=1, nosuid/nodev/noexec; verify new storage-source socket addresses; raw-read 64 MiB at 48 GiB; finally unmount and remove. Production mount unchanged. Diagnostic soft mount options are not proposed production configuration.
